At quarter-end, the Common Equity Tier 1 (CET1) (2) and Tier 1 capital (2) ratios were estimated at 10.8 percent and 11.9 percent respectively. During the third quarter, the company repurchased approximately 3 million shares of common stock for a total of $95 million through open-market purchases and declared $255 million in dividends to common shareholders. The company's liquidity position also remained robust with total available liquidity as of Sept. 30, 2026, of approximately $64 billion, which includes cash held at the Federal Reserve, FHLB borrowing capacity, unencumbered securities, and capacity at the Federal Reserve's facilities such as the Discount Window or Standing Repo Operations. These sources are sufficient to cover uninsured deposits at a ratio of approximately 170 percent as of quarter-end (excluding intercompany and secured deposits).
